findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: name_a_number, get_report, list_feeds · Private data: receipts, submit_forecast, find_index, list_indices, get_index, get_listing_kit, name_a_number · Public sink: board, base_rate, receipts, open_questions, submit_forecast, get_index, name_a_number · Destructive: get_index.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: name_a_number, get_report, list_feeds · Private data: receipts, submit_forecast, find_index, list_indices, get_index, get_listing_kit, name_a_number · Public sink: board, base_rate, receipts, open_questions, submit_forecast, get_index, name_a_number · Destructive: get_index

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
